text: Build and ship full-stack apps entirely from an AI chat interface
quote: build and ship full-stack apps without leaving your AI chat

text: Add Floot as a remote MCP server to Cursor, VS Code, Zed, or any MCP-compatible client
quote: Add Floot to Cursor, VS Code, Zed, or any client that supports remote MCP servers

text: get_logs tool lets an agent fetch logs to debug errors like 500s or blank pages
quote: get_logs — the first step for any 500, blank page, or failed request.

text: Database tools (query_database, execute_sql, pull_database_schema) let an agent read, write, migrate, and regenerate typed schema helpers
quote: query_database for reads, execute_sql for writes and migrations, pull_database_schema to regenerate typed helpers.

text: create_checkpoint marks a restorable point you can revert to from the project's Checkpoint panel
quote: create_checkpoint labels a point you can revert to from the Checkpoint panel in your project view.

text: Point at an element or annotate a screenshot so the AI assistant can target that spot for edits
quote: point at an element or annotate a screenshot for the assistant to pick up

text: generate_image tool creates AI-generated images directly inside the project
quote: generate_image writes AI images into the project.

text: Credits can be added on demand instead of requiring a plan upgrade or downgrade
quote: you no longer have to upgrade or downgrade your plan — just add credits whenever you need them.

text: Converts a project into native iOS and Android apps
quote: Floot converts your project into native iOS and Android apps

text: Built-in visitor tracking shows page views, traffic sources, and trends
quote: Built-in visitor tracking: page views, traffic sources, and trends.

text: Export the app's code and database to deploy on any hosting of your choice
quote: you can export the code and the database and deploy them wherever you like.

text: Apps can send push notifications to users' devices, even when the app is backgrounded
quote: Your apps can now send push notifications — the little alerts that pop up on your users' devices — even when your app is in the background.

text: Apps can send and receive email natively without needing a third-party email service
quote: Your apps can now send AND receive email — no third-party email service needed.
